The idea in the broad sense is very simple. item.description: Brandon Hurst began his journey into plant selling in 2020 as a side project to boost his income. item.title: Georgia woman wins $975,000 after falling at Walmart, but appeals court overturns verdict
item.description: A Georgia woman who won $975,000 after a fall at a Walmart store in 2020 will face a new trial after an appeals court overturned the verdict on October 29. The court found that her lawyer had improperly compared compensation for pain and suffering with an expert witness's $8,000 daily fee and minimum-wage rates. Judges ruled that these unrelated comparisons could have influenced the jury's decision. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: First Phase Restoration: Basilica’s $7.7m repairs halt leaks; visitors face limited hours
item.description: The historic basilica in Asheville, North Carolina, recently marked the successful completion of its first restoration phase, costing $7.7 million. This essential initiative concentrated on addressing water damage and safeguarding the architectural masterpiece. Key upgrades included the replacement of the copper dome and reinforcing key masonry sections, paving the way for future restoration phases that rely on ongoing fundraising efforts and the building's status as a cultural treasure. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
